name: LubeLogger
description: Self-hosted vehicle service, fuel, expenses and reminders. Owner/fleet tracker; not a complete shop ERP.

name: ERPNext

name: OpenAuto
description: Advertises open-source shop management, estimates and scheduling. Website claim only; repository and maintenance status require verification.
